notes.title: Version 1.0.5 Update
notes.notes:
Includes: 

- A new "Hardcore" difficulty mode
- 2 new classes
- A panic indicator to the UI
- 3 new achievements for Hardcore mode

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 Update
notes.notes:
Includes:

-Fixed an issue with the grenades
-Added a dex penalty to body armour
-Added extra aim bonus to pistols and reduced aim bonus on rifles for balance
-Reduced confusion for bosses to half player strength

note: Some changes may not take affect until you've started a new game.

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Update
notes.notes:
Includes: 

-Selector now goes to closest enemy/item, can be cycled with the "z" and "v" keys
-Fixed an issue with the stats screen not closing unless clicked, can now be closed with "Esc"
-Updated the stat descriptors in the inventory to make them clearer
-Updated the enemy AI so they now continue to chase you even if you go out of sight
-Updated level transitions to display the type of level the player is moving into
-Reduced the number of Rocks and Knives and updated both items to use the strength stat for determining stun time and range respectively
-Critical hits and explosions now cause panic

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Update
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where exits weren't displaying properly in certain levels.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 update
notes.notes:
Includes:

-New sprites for Sergeant and Medic classes (a new save will have to be started to view these changes but old saves will still work as normal)
-Fixed a spelling mistake on the class selection screen
-Added controls display to pause menu
-added the ability to close "select an item to pickup" window with the Esc key
